title: A person to read the Câmara de Lisboa's measures page
summary: Ask a person to open the Câmara's page on its measures for Wednesday (lisboa.pt and informacao.lisboa.pt refuse our tools) and tell the conductor what it says, with the address and the time.
closes: The page is read by a person and the edge camara-plan carries what it says.
blocks: The city's own measures stay "unknown" in the decision graph.
